description: Return the task Schronu currently recommends working on in the task field; task is null when no task is available.
name: get_focus

description: Return an existing task by its UUID.

task_id.description: The UUID of the existing task to return.

name: get_task

description: List tasks in project-tree pre-order, optionally filtered by period, effective status, and category. Different filters are combined using AND.

categories.description: Categories to include. Values within the array are combined using OR, and null selects uncategorized tasks. Omit this field or pass an empty array to skip category filtering.

period.description: A half-open RFC 3339 date-time range [from, until) applied to the selected task field. This filter is combined with status and category filters using AND. Omit this field to skip period filtering.

field.description: The task date-time field to filter. scheduled_start selects tasks with at least one calculated schedule segment whose start is within the range; created_at, deadline, and completed_at select their corresponding timestamps.

from.description: The inclusive start of the period as an RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset. Must be earlier than until.

until.description: The exclusive end of the period as an RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset. Must be later than from.

statuses.description: Effective task statuses to include. Values within the array are combined using OR. Omit this field or pass an empty array to skip status filtering.

name: list_tasks

description: Return calculated schedule segments whose intervals overlap the selected range of local logical days. Logical days start at 06:00 local time.

from.description: The logical date at the inclusive start of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format without a time or time zone. Its boundary is 06:00 local time. With no until, selects this one logical day; with no from or until, the range starts now.

until.description: The logical date at the exclusive end of the range, in YYYY-MM-DD format without a time or time zone. Its boundary is 06:00 local time. With no from, the range starts now; with neither bound, it ends at the next 06:00 boundary.

name: get_schedule

description: Create a new root project task. The task starts as Todo unless pending_until is provided, in which case it starts as Pending.

estimated_work_minutes.description: The estimated work duration as a non-negative integer number of minutes. When provided, it is converted to seconds; when omitted, the task keeps the default estimate of 15 minutes.

name.description: The task name. After trimming surrounding whitespace, it must not be blank or consist only of an optionally signed integer.

pending_until.description: The time until which the task remains Pending, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset. When omitted, the task starts as Todo.

name: create_task

description: Add child tasks to an existing parent task in the order supplied. Every child inherits the parent's deadline when it has one, and starts as Todo unless pending_until is provided, in which case every child starts as Pending.

names.description: One or more child task names, added to the parent in this array order.

items.description: A child task name. After trimming surrounding whitespace, it must not be blank or consist only of an optionally signed integer.

parent_id.description: The UUID of the existing parent task to which the children are added.

pending_until.description: The common time until which every created child remains Pending, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset. When omitted, every child starts as Todo.

name: breakdown_task

description: Defer a task until an absolute date and time.

pending_until.description: An RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset.

name: defer_task

description: Defer a routine task to its next repetition cycle.
name: defer_routine_task

description: Complete a task, optionally recording finish time and work seconds.

finished_at.description: An RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset.

name: complete_task

description: Update a task's estimate, deadline, or category.

anyOf.description: An RFC 3339 date-time string with Z or a numeric UTC offset.

name: update_task
